description: Weekly salon suite and chair rent for one US state. state is a required 2-letter code, such as FL. Pass city with state for one city, such as Orlando. City match is case-insensitive: exact name, then a name that starts with the city, then a name that contains it. Without city, markets are the largest by usable posted-price count. limit defaults to 25 and maxes at 100. Only markets with at least 8 usable posted prices. Counts are spaces within 25 miles. When truncated is true, raise limit or pass city.
name: city_rents
title: Rent by city
